text: All fees should be shared with the entire network of reputation holders in proportion to their holdings, because this reputational salary is what makes reputation tokens valuable and future-oriented.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, The Importance of Reputation for the Evolution of Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782210
